entities.summary: George Walker was an English chess player and author of The Celebrated Analysis of A D Philidor, The Art of Chess-Play: A New Treatise on the Game of Chess, A Selection of Games at Chess played by Philidor, Chess Made Easy, and Chess Studies. His father was a publisher and novelist.
